main.description: A post in a book club discussion, stored in the author's repo inside the club's space. Threading follows the aggregator-forum shape: every post carries a root (the bookClub.thread) and a parent; a top-level post is its own parent (parent == root), while a reply's parent is another post in the same thread. Linear readers can ignore parent beyond the root; tree readers can rebuild the tree. The space, not the record, is the access boundary.

text.description: The post body. Empty is allowed when the post is only a reply marker, though a discussion post normally has text.

langs.description: Human language of the text, BCP 47 tags.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the post was created.

replyRef.description: Thread position. `root` MUST be a net.olamaelcu.livtet.bookClub.thread record in the same space. `parent` MUST be that thread (for a top-level post, where parent == root) or another net.olamaelcu.livtet.bookClub.post in the same space whose own root matches. StrongRefs pin the revision being answered, as app.bsky.feed.post does; grouping compares `root.uri`, so an edited thread keeps one discussion.
